overview.summary: A large architect-designed home built into a steeply sloping site, arranged over a basement and two levels above (up to three levels on the slope). The basement holds a four-car garage, theatre and storage; upper levels contain the kitchen, living, dining, studio, master suite and three further bedrooms with ensuites, plus a walk-in-robe and separate studio. Construction is substantial: a piled basement retention system with shotcrete and Dincel/block retaining walls, bored piers and a reinforced suspended concrete slab, timber and steel-framed upper structure, and a Colorbond metal roof with box gutters. Notable features include a reinforced concrete lap pool, a residential lift, extensive polished-plaster (Marmorino) finishes, double-glazed aluminium windows, ducted air-conditioning, a fireplace, and a landscaped garden with sauna, firepit and reflection ponds.
